about: The page presets: every piece a Shrine page may be drawn from, each naming the Goo constructor it is. One source: the browser renderer (presets.js), Tidy and the agent's page skill read this file; a preset not listed here is not drawn.

blocks.name: paragraph
blocks.syntax: plain lines; a blank line ends one

blocks.name: table
blocks.syntax: | a | b | with a header row and | --- | --- |: a collection, one row per thing

blocks.name: quote
blocks.syntax: > lines of someone else's words; the last line > — who · how, when

blocks.name: embed
blocks.syntax: [[/path]] alone on a line: that record or folder, live, where it stands

inline.name: link
inline.syntax: /path: a link to a thing, shown by its name

inline.name: live
inline.syntax: /path#slot: that slot's value as it is now

inline.name: hole
inline.syntax: {{? lead time}}, or {{? days /path#lead_time}} bound to the slot its answer fills: a blank to ask for

inline.name: missing
inline.syntax: {{! no contact}}: something missing that needs the owner

inline.name: source
inline.syntax: ^[quote p.1]: where the fact just before it came from
